text:
jamie: Hey team — quick sync. I opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/41299 to change routing for small-model fallbacks and tweak the allocator order. Requesting runtime + infra + platform + security eyes. High level: reduces median token latency for short requests, risk is transient memory bump during cold-concurrent loads.

mike: I'll take runtime perf. Can you paste the perf job output?

jamie: added perf summary in the PR description. TL;DR: 8-12% p50 improvement on 128-token distribution, p99 unchanged in synthetic.

linh: @mike I can reproduce the cold-start pattern locally. One quick ask: add a short rollback tag so we can flip routing back without a rebuild.

jamie: done — added a feature flag and rollback note in the runbook.

sarah: CCing eng-security: the change adjusts header propagation order for auth tokens. Is that compatible with existing sigs?

jamie: yes — preserved header order and added compatibility tests. See snippet in PR: ```python
# preserve header order for auth
for h in headers: if h.name == 'Authorization': target.append(h)
```

deploy-bot: CI passed — unit 216/216, integration 14/14, e2e flaky-ignored.

mike: skimmed tests, adding one more unit to cover LRU boundary. I'll push a tiny test in a follow-up commit.

alex: platform - I can own the merge window tomorrow 12:00 PT. Can you add a short canary plan? I'll coordinate routing changes.

jamie: canary plan added to PR, schedule: 10% (30m) -> 50% (30m) -> 100% if healthy. Rollback if error rate delta > 0.5% or latency regresses >10% at p50.

linh: I'll run the canary and monitor memory + eviction metrics. tag me as owner.

sarah: security quick note: need a short blurb in PR description about KMS usage and service-account access.

jamie: added KMS blurb and IAM checklist.

alex: sounds good. @mike please confirm after your unit added. After that I'll schedule merge and tag release notes.

mike: unit test pushed, CI running. If green, lgtm from runtime.

jamie: thanks everyone — big help. I'll wait for CI and then handoff to @alex for merge. :rocket:
